slice: P2 AC1027 MLINE group-71 flags across two- and four-vertex offset projections
productionChange: None. The existing bounded MLINE projection path accepted the newly authored two- and four-vertex profiles; this slice adds source/output/readback and transaction evidence only.
scope: Qualify direct consumed-style offset reprojection for selected AC1027 MLINE vertex counts 2 and 4 under group-71 flags 1, 5, 9 and 13. The existing three-vertex selector remains a separate profile.

specEvidence.group71: Bit 1 indicates at least one vertex, bit 2 marks closed, bit 4 suppresses start caps, and bit 8 suppresses end caps.
specEvidence.group41: Per-element segment parameters are real-valued lists whose entries describe segment intersections, starts and cuts.
specEvidence.interpretation: The test isolates group-71 state and group-72 counts while changing one consumed style offset. It checks exact modeled geometry and projected group-41 values; it does not qualify native rendering or general MLINE editing.

contract.admission: Runtime-authored AC1027 source profile with exactly two consumed MLINESTYLE elements. Group-72 vertex counts are 2 or 4; group-71 values are 1, 5, 9 or 13. The first style offset changes 1.25→1.5 while the second remains -0.75. Closed value 3 and unknown-bit value 17 refuse.
contract.outputAndReadback: Thirty-two positive combinations cover 2 vertex counts × 4 group-71 profiles × ASCII/binary input/output. Physical output verifies groups 71/72, every group-41 value, and both ENTITIES/BLOCKS consumers. Fresh typed readback verifies vertex count, all positions/directions/miters, style offsets, flags and projected parameters.
contract.failureAndRetry: Eight refusal profiles cover closed/unknown flags × 2 vertex counts × 2 output encodings with destination and caller preservation; corrected group-71=13 sources then succeed through the same adapter. Four late parameter-mutation failures preserve the destination and succeed through same-adapter retry after restoring caller state.
contract.compatibility: The selected three-vertex offset, cap-flag, append/removal and angle/offset retarget selectors remain passing. This receipt qualifies only authored AC1027 DXF profiles; it says nothing about DWG group-71/group-72 semantics, other counts, closed paths, filled/cut MLINEs, other versions or native display. No drawing fixture was committed.

sourceBindings.fixtureRecipe: tests/dxf_fixture_tests.cpp creates two- and four-vertex source records at runtime from explicit coordinates, segment directions, miters and group-41 values; output checks physical records and freshly imported typed state.

focusedSelectors.summary: 7/7 passed in 2.84s; includes the new 2/4-vertex matrix and affected 3-vertex, cap-flag, append/removal and retarget regressions.

validation.asan: NOT_RUN; this slice changes runtime fixture generation and assertions only, with no production allocation/ownership path change.

limitations: Only runtime-authored AC1027 two- and four-vertex offset-edit profiles are newly covered; three vertices and other operations remain separate evidence.
Group-71 preservation does not qualify cap appearance, closed MLINE projection, or group-42 fill/cut projection.
No DWG byte layout or DWG flag semantics were changed or inferred.
